t: By the fig and the olive
We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

f.228254: - Referring to the places known for their production, i.e., Damascus and Jerusalem, respectively. It could also refer to the fig and olive trees or to the fruits themselves.
f.228255: - i.e., upright, symmetrical, and balanced in form and nature.
f.228256: - This can refer to the depths of Hell, to decrepit old age or to immorality.
f.228257: - More literally, "What makes you lie concerning it?"
